content.short: Tonhub is a mobile-first TON wallet focused on security and simplicity, featuring integrated staking and dApp access.
content.description: Tonhub is a mobile-focused, non-custodial wallet tailored for the TON blockchain, emphasizing both high security and ease of use. It allows users to store Toncoin securely, participate in integrated staking pools to earn rewards, and browse decentralized applications through its built-in explorer. With a clean interface and optimized performance, Tonhub simplifies the Web3 experience for mobile users while ensuring they retain full control over their private keys and digital assets.
content.meta: Secure your TON assets with Tonhub, a mobile-first non-custodial wallet. Join staking pools and explore dApps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
